## Common WHERE Filters

| Filter | Example | Frequency |
|--------|---------|-----------|
| `grass_date = date('${grass_date}')` | Single day partition | Very High |
| `grass_date BETWEEN date('...') AND date('...')` | Date range (7d/14d/30d) | High |
| `grass_region = upper('${region}')` | Single region variable | Very High |
| `grass_region IN ('ID','MY','PH','SG','TH','TW','VN','BR')` | Standard 8 regions | High |
| `tz_type = 'local'` | Local timezone | Very High |
| `first_touchpoint_item = 1` | First touchpoint attribution | Very High |
| `user_id > 0` | Valid user filter | High |
| `feature_group_omni = 'Search'` | Search entrance filter | Medium |
| `feature_group_omni IN ('Search','You May Also Like','Live Streaming',...)` | Entrance group filter | Medium |
| `feature_detail_omni LIKE 'image_search-%'` | Image search entrance | Low |
| `feature_detail_omni LIKE '%-shop_item'` | Shop item feature | Medium |
| `module = 'Global Search'` / `module = 'Daily Discover'` | Module-level filter | Medium |
| `click_common_property.is_ads = true` | Ads attribution (click level) | Medium |
| `click_location_property.location > 0` | Valid ad location | Low |

## Common JOIN Patterns

### 1. JOIN with AB test user groups

```sql
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di__reg_sensitive_live a
INNER JOIN abtest.abtest_mart_dws_assignment_agg_1d b
  ON a.user_id = b.user_id
  AND a.grass_date = b.grass_date
  AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region
```

### 2. JOIN with order commission

```sql
FROM (...subquery on dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di...) omni_order_info
LEFT OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT order_id, commission_fee_usd, commission_fee, gmv, gmv_usd
  FROM mp_order.dwd_order_item_place_pay_complete_di__reg_s0_live
) order_commission_info
ON omni_order_info.order_id = order_commission_info.order_id
```

### 3. JOIN with item dimension

```sql
FROM platform_gmv a   -- aggregated from dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di
LEFT JOIN mp_item.dim_item__reg_s0_live b
  ON a.item_id = b.item_id
  AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region
  AND a.grass_date = b.grass_date
```

### 4. JOIN with sales funnel (user-item level)

```sql
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dws_user_item_feature_sales_funnel_metrics_1d__reg_sensitive_live gmv_table
JOIN (
  SELECT grass_date, grass_region, order_id, user_id, order_item_id AS item_id,
    SUM(item_amount * atc_prorate * last_touchpoint_item) AS item_sold_cnt
  FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di__reg_sensitive_live
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
) sold_table
ON sold_table.item_id = gmv_table.item_id AND sold_table.user_id = gmv_table.user_id
```

### 5. JOIN with revenue/rebate tables (order-item-model level)

```sql
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di__reg_sensitive_live
-- join keys: order_id, item_id (order_item_id), order_model_id, group_id, bundle_order_item_id
JOIN mp_mgmt.dws_order_item_rev_di__reg_s0_live
  ON order_id, item_id, model_id, group_id, bundle_order_item_id
```

## Common Aggregations

### GMV Metrics (USD)

```sql
-- Platform GMV (first touchpoint, ATC prorated)
SUM(gmv_usd * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item)

-- Platform GMV (local currency)
SUM(gmv * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item)

-- Seller GMV
SUM(place_sellergmv_usd * atc_prorate)
```

### Order Metrics

```sql
-- Order count (fractional, prorated)
SUM(order_fraction * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item)

-- Item sold count
SUM(item_amount * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item)
-- Also seen with last_touchpoint_item:
SUM(item_amount * atc_prorate * last_touchpoint_item)
```

### GMV by Ads vs Organic

```sql
-- Using is_ads flag from struct properties
SUM(CASE WHEN click_common_property.is_ads = true THEN gmv_usd * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item ELSE 0 END) AS ads_gmv
SUM(CASE WHEN click_common_property.is_ads != true THEN gmv_usd * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item ELSE 0 END) AS organic_gmv

-- Combined is_ads across touchpoints
CASE WHEN (click_common_property.is_ads = true
    OR source1_common_property.is_ads = true
    OR source2_common_property.is_ads = true) THEN true ELSE false END AS is_ads
```

### GMV by Entrance (feature_group_omni / module based)

```sql
-- Search GMV
SUM(CASE WHEN feature_group_omni = 'Search' AND module = 'Global Search' THEN gmv_usd * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item END) AS gs_gmv

-- Daily Discover GMV
SUM(CASE WHEN module = 'Daily Discover' THEN gmv_usd * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item END) AS dd_gmv

-- Live Streaming GMV
SUM(CASE WHEN feature_group_omni = 'Live Streaming' THEN gmv_usd * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item END) AS live_gmv

-- YMAL GMV
SUM(CASE WHEN feature_group_omni = 'You May Also Like' THEN gmv_usd * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item END) AS ymal_gmv
```

### GROUP BY Dimensions

```sql
-- Typical: daily x region
GROUP BY grass_date, grass_region

-- AB test: daily x region x group
GROUP BY grass_date, grass_region, group_id

-- Item-level: item x shop x entrance
GROUP BY order_item_id, shop_id, entrance

-- User-level: user x item x common_feature
GROUP BY user_id, item_id, common_feature
```

### Snippet 1: Platform order/GMV for livestream tracker

```sql
WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
```

### Snippet 3: Common feature attribution with multi-touchpoint UNION ALL

```sql
-- Source: workflows/dws/ab_test/dws_advertise_user_exp_common_feature_performance_1d
-- Pattern: UNION ALL of 4 subqueries (step0=click, step1=source1, step2=source2, all_steps=Platform)

-- step 0 (click touchpoint)
SELECT ..., click_common_property.is_ads AS is_ads,
  click_location_property.location AS location,
  CASE
    WHEN module = 'Global Search' THEN 'Global Search'
    WHEN module = 'Daily Discover' THEN 'Daily Discover'
    WHEN feature_group_omni = 'You May Also Like' THEN 'You May Also Like'
    WHEN feature_group_omni = 'Live Streaming' THEN 'Live Streaming'
    ...
    ELSE 'Others'
  END AS common_feature
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}') AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local' AND user_id > 0

UNION ALL

-- step 1 (source1 touchpoint)
SELECT ..., source1_common_property.is_ads AS is_ads, ...
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di__reg_sensitive_live ...

UNION ALL
-- step 2 (source2 touchpoint) ...

UNION ALL
-- all steps (Platform level, combined is_ads)
SELECT ...,
  (click_common_property.is_ads OR source1_common_property.is_ads OR source2_common_property.is_ads) AS is_ads,
  'Platform' AS common_feature
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di__reg_sensitive_live ...
```

### Snippet 4: Entrance-based diagnosis (entrance mapping from click_common_property.entrance)

```sql
-- Source: workflows/ads_diagnosis/dws_omni_item_shop_entrance_metrics_daily
SELECT
  order_item_id AS item_id, shop_id,
  CASE click_common_property.entrance
    WHEN 3 THEN 'DD'   WHEN 4 THEN 'YMAL'
    WHEN 1 THEN 'SEARCH' WHEN 23 THEN 'SEARCH'
    WHEN 8 THEN 'PP' WHEN 9 THEN 'PP' WHEN 10 THEN 'PP' WHEN 11 THEN 'PP'
    WHEN 29 THEN 'VIDEO' WHEN 31 THEN 'VIDEO' ...
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS entrance,
  SUM(place_sellergmv_usd * atc_prorate) AS total_seller_gmv_usd
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE grass_region = '${REGION}' AND grass_date = DATE '${ISO_YESTERDAY}'
  AND first_touchpoint_item = 1
GROUP BY 1,2,3
```

### Snippet 5: Item-level GMV by minute for bidding

```sql
-- Source: scheduled_tasks/platform_gmv_by_item_id_and_minute_for_ads_bidding
SELECT grass_region, grass_date, order_item_id AS item_id,
  CASE WHEN click_common_property.is_ads = true OR source1_common_property.is_ads = true
    OR source2_common_property.is_ads = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_ads,
  IF(feature_group_omni = 'Search', 1, 2) AS scenario,
  order_fraction * atc_prorate AS order_1d,
  gmv * atc_prorate AS gmv_1d,
  gmv_usd * atc_prorate AS gmv_usd_1d,
  -- Local time conversion for hour/minute
  CASE WHEN grass_region = 'ID' THEN
    hour(from_utc_timestamp(to_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(order_place_timestamp), 'Asia/Shanghai'), 'Asia/Jakarta'))
  ...
  END AS hh
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE grass_date = date('...') AND grass_region IN ('PH','TH','VN')
  AND tz_type = 'local' AND first_touchpoint_item = 1
```

### Snippet 6: Entrypoint GMV tracker (multi-entrance CASE WHEN)

```sql
-- Source: personal/luka.yang/sql/ads_key_metric_tracker.sql
SELECT
  CAST((from_unixtime(order_place_timestamp) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Singapore') AS DATE) grass_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (business_line = 'Search' AND module = 'Global Search')
    OR (source1_business_line = 'Search' AND source1_module = 'Global Search')
    OR (source2_business_line = 'Search' AND source2_module = 'Global Search')
    THEN gmv_usd * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item END) gs_gmv,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (business_line = 'Homepage' AND module = 'Daily Discover')
    OR (source1_business_line = 'Homepage' AND source1_module = 'Daily Discover')
    OR (source2_business_line = 'Homepage' AND source2_module = 'Daily Discover')
    THEN gmv_usd * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item END) dd_gmv,
  ...
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE grass_date >= date '2024-10-31'
  AND first_touchpoint_item = 1 AND user_id > 0
  AND grass_region IN ('ID','BR','PH','TH','MY','VN','SG','TW')
GROUP BY 1
```

### Snippet 8: Revenue attribution with PC2 (commission + rebate)

```sql
-- Source: workflows/dws/revenue/dws_common_feature_user_item_pc2_1d
SELECT grass_date, order_id, order_item_id AS item_id,
  order_model_id AS model_id, group_id, bundle_order_item_id,
  user_id, common_feature,
  SUM(COALESCE(gmv_usd * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item, 0)) AS gmv_usd
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date('${grass_date_30day}') AND date('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}') AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND user_id > 0 AND first_touchpoint_item = 1
-- JOIN keys for revenue tables: order_id, item_id, model_id, group_id, bundle_order_item_id
```

| Platform GMV (USD) | `SUM(gmv_usd * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item)` | 10+ files |
| Platform Order Count | `SUM(order_fraction * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item)` | 10+ files |
